exposure: pet keeping in the residence at aged 0-1 year
passive smoking by child in the current residence
having mould or hygroma in the child's residence at aged 0-1 year
purchasing new furniture in the mother's residence during pregnancy
Home environment factors (carpet or floor bedding, new furniture, pet keeping, passive smoking, mould or hygroma)
carpet or floor bedding at home
ethnicity other than the Han Chinese
cohort: 8153 preschool children in Urumqi, Xinjiang, China
finding: Several factors, including caesarean section, family history of asthma, certain home environment characteristics, and passive smoking, were associated with an increased risk of wheeze and asthma in preschool children.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a risk factor for both wheeze and asthma in this study.
